evals.prompt: Bake a triangulated game prop normal, AO and material signals from retained high-poly sources with a documented cage.
evals.expected_output: An editable, scoped result with discipline-specific settings, actual evidence and stated unverified gates.
assertions: Preserves source/cage and restores active nodes or temporary material overrides.
Distinguishes projection, tangent and padding artifacts from sampling noise.
Uses float encoding for data needing range and validates files plus actual images.

evals.prompt: Neighboring bolts ghost into the bake, seams appear in-engine and position data was clamped to PNG. Repair projection and encoding.
evals.expected_output: A diagnosis tied to the supplied failure, preserved sources, a concrete correction and repeated affected acceptance checks.
assertions: Preserves source/cage and restores active nodes or temporary material overrides.
Distinguishes projection, tangent and padding artifacts from sampling noise.
Uses float encoding for data needing range and validates files plus actual images.
Does not label a hypothetical plan, a structural assertion or unrun workflow as successful execution.

evals.prompt: Torso HIGH has procedural color and mixed shaders inside a group, a transparent visor intercepts rays, and low LOD10 has different UVs. Bake requested maps and rebuild portable materials.
evals.expected_output: Explicit high/low geometry and surface-source mapping, supported signal extraction or unresolved map, transparent exclusion, separate LOD10 bake and preserved alpha/emission roles.
assertions: Does not use first Principled as arbitrary group/mix semantics.
No missing UV/HIGH or unknown map silent success.
